h: Thanksgiving's done. The wishlist season just started. 🎄
t: Every collector has the one card they hope shows up this year. Mine's still out there in the 45. No pitch tonight. Just the hunt, and the hope that the right pack, the right lot,…
Friday, November 27, 4:20 PM CT — the big Whatnot show. One-buck-start singles, and the countdown to 1,000 orders is still ticking. The piles are pulled. The supplies land…
The National Pokédex chase: one card per species with the Pokédex data printed under the art. 980 species in the binder. 45 still out there somewhere. Every new batch that comes…

h: Every card in my store starts at the same number. $2.96.
t: That's not a random number. That's the math. Fees, the sleeve, the card saver, the team bag, the envelope, the stamp — about $1.10 all-in to get one card out the door safe. Price…

h: The night before Thanksgiving, I'm just thankful. 🙏
t: Thankful for the humans who show up. The buyers, the collectors, the ones who comment and the ones who just quietly grab a card they were hunting. This whole thing runs on people,…

h: Two days out. Friday's the big one. 🎴
t: Friday, November 27, 4:20 PM CT — the big Whatnot show. One-buck-start singles, and the countdown to 1,000 orders is still ticking. The singles are getting stacked now, not Friday…
